transcript.text: Hi everyone, I'm Mara, the Awards Producer. I need to get the Horizon Feature Award presentation protocol locked and the rundown distributed for Saturday's televised ceremony. Before I can lock anything, festival production policy requires round-robin sign-off from stage management, broadcast standards, legal, and accessibility. The current draft has the recipient using the south stairs, a 30-second stage cue, no broadcast delay, the festival sponsor wall as backdrop, and a 42-inch podium. I'd like to walk through each area's concerns so we can get sign-offs and I can distribute the locked rundown. Who'd like to start?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: During the final stage walk-through, I measured that the south stairs leave the recipient's camera path obstructed. The approved route is the north ramp, and the stage cue must be 90 seconds rather than 30 seconds. I have not entered this in the master rundown yet.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a broadcast standards issue. I confirmed with the network control room this afternoon that the Horizon Feature Award must run on a 10-second broadcast delay, with the acceptance microphone live through that delay. The current no-delay setting in the draft rundown is not approved. I have not updated the broadcast log yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a legal issue before sign-off. My review of the signed sponsor agreement found that the sponsor wall may not appear behind the Horizon Feature Award recipient. The backdrop must be the festival's neutral blue curtain, with no sponsor logo in that shot. I have not attached the clause to the ceremony file yet, but the current draft rundown's use of the festival sponsor wall as backdrop is not compliant with the agreement.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to flag an accessibility issue before sign-off. During the recipient's access rehearsal, I confirmed that the recipient uses a wheelchair and needs the podium lowered to exactly 36 inches — the current draft's 42-inch podium will not work. The accessibility plan must also record a north-ramp access accommodation. I have not added the rehearsal result to the production packet yet.
transcript.speaker: A5

decisions.backdrop: festival's neutral blue curtain, no sponsor logo

commitments.detail: Enter north ramp route and 90-second stage cue into the master rundown.
Update the broadcast log to reflect the 10-second broadcast delay with acceptance microphone live through that delay.
Attach the sponsor agreement clause to the ceremony file and confirm neutral blue curtain backdrop with no sponsor logo.
Add the rehearsal result to the production packet, recording the 36-inch podium height and north-ramp access accommodation.
Lock the updated rundown with all four sign-offs and distribute to all stakeholders.
